Column.description: One column of a BOM or CPL file.

header.description: The column header, such as "LCSC Part #".

ColumnSource.description: Where a BOM or CPL column takes its values from.

oneOf.description: The Designators of the row, in natural order (CPL: the one Designator).
How many Components the BOM row groups.
The Footprint's centre, X, in mm from the CPL origin.
The Footprint's centre, Y, in mm from the CPL origin.
The Footprint's rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise.
The Component field with this name, such as `LCSC` or `MPN`.

FabRules.description:
A Fab Preset's design rules: flat limits with no scope, which a job compares the board
with, and the preferred values a new board's routing starts from.

annular_ring.description: Minimum annular ring of Vias and plated Pads.

clearance.description: Minimum clearance between copper of different Nets.

edge_clearance.description: Minimum clearance from copper to the Board Outline and Board Cutouts.

hole_max.description: Maximum Pad, Free Pad and non-plated hole.

hole_min.description: Minimum Pad, Free Pad and non-plated hole.

preferred.description:
The preferred sizes a new board is seeded with. They are never compared with the
board.

FileNaming.description: How the Gerber and drill files of a job are named.

oneOf.description: Protel extensions: `.GTL`, `.GBL`, `.GTS`, … and `.GKO` for the Board Outline.

GerberSettings.description: The Gerber and drill switches of a Fab Preset.

x2_attributes.description: Write Gerber X2 attributes (`.FileFunction` and friends); off writes plain X1.

MaskExpansion.description: The board's solder-mask seed values. Tenting here applies only to Vias.

bottom.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

top.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

expansion.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

PasteExpansion.description: The board's paste seed: length per edge or signed change in area in percent.

PreferredSeeds.description: The preferred Track and Via sizes a Fab Preset seeds a new board with.

track_width.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

via_diameter.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

via_hole.description: A length or coordinate in integer nanometres. Serialises as a bare integer.

StackupSeeds.description:
A new board's Stackup values, from its Fab Preset. A value left out uses the fallback:
[`DEFAULT_BOARD_THICKNESS`] and [`DEFAULT_COPPER`].

copper.description: The copper thickness of every copper Layer.

format.description: The file-format version. REDA writes only the current one.

name.description: The preset's name, as the New Project dialog lists it.

rules.description:
The flat limits a job checks the board against, and the preferred seeds of a new
board's rules.

stackup.description:
The thickness and copper a new board's Stackup starts with; left out when the
preset seeds neither, and then a new board gets 1.6 mm and 1 oz.
